charterV5.body: Funding proposals must primarily support open-source developer infrastructure. A proposal whose funded product is closed-source or proprietary does not satisfy this requirement. Changing a closed-source product into an open-source one would change the proposal's fundamental purpose.
charterV5.title: Mission

charterV5.body: Funding recipients must disclose their material team token allocation. The disclosed allocation must be supported by VERIFIED evidence attached to the proposal.
charterV5.title: Transparency

charterV5.body: Every funding proposal must contain a specific budget breakdown listing an amount for each cost category. A missing budget breakdown is a curable proposal deficiency.
charterV5.title: Budget

charterV5.body: Every funding proposal must state a delivery timeline with at least one dated milestone. A missing timeline is a curable proposal deficiency.
charterV5.title: Timeline
